RPSC-ANAL.description: PSC Rating Analysis (RPSC-ANAL). Runs the AASHTO-LRFR19 PSC rating execution; the single Argument.TYPE field selects the analysis mode, which the handler forces to the rating branch.

Argument.description: Request DTO (ANL_PSC) that drives the PSC rating analysis.

TYPE.description: Analysis mode selector (case-insensitive on the wire). The handler hard-rejects any value other than PERFORM_RATING for this rating endpoint (throws LV_WRONG_FIELD). Wire values of the underlying enum are PSC_PERFORM_DESIGN and PERFORM_RATING.
